prompt: Create an Angular 21 ApiService with retry interceptor, HttpContextToken, and HttpTestingController tests

assertions.name: functional-interceptor-signature
assertions.description: Retry interceptor uses HttpInterceptorFn signature (req: HttpRequest<unknown>, next: HttpHandlerFn)

assertions.name: http-context-token-usage
assertions.description: Defines RETRY_COUNT as HttpContextToken with default value and uses req.context.get()

assertions.name: exponential-backoff-pattern
assertions.description: Uses RxJS retry() with delay function implementing exponential backoff (e.g., Math.pow(2, retryCount) * 1000 or similar)

assertions.name: status-code-filtering
assertions.description: Only retries on 503 and 429, throws/rethrows for other error statuses

assertions.name: http-error-response-distinction
assertions.description: Service distinguishes network errors (status === 0) from backend errors (status > 0) using HttpErrorResponse

assertions.name: provider-ordering
assertions.description: Tests use provideHttpClient() before provideHttpClientTesting() in TestBed providers

assertions.name: with-interceptors-in-test
assertions.description: Interceptor test registers the interceptor via withInterceptors() in TestBed

assertions.name: inject-function
assertions.description: Uses inject() function for DI, not constructor injection
